newsitem.title: USA: Discount Auto Parts says it restates Q2.
newsitem.headline: Discount Auto Parts says it restates Q2.

text.p: Discount Auto Parts Inc said it restated certain aspects of its fiscal 1997 second quarter ended Nov. 26, 1996 which would adjust the accounting treatment for certain transactions associated with commercial sales of freon.
The company said that the adjustments would have no effect on the net income or earnings per share previously reported for the second quarter.

The company's commercial sales of freon were expected to be reduced during the third quarter and the company does not anticipate any significant commercial sales of freon in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997.

As previously disclosed, certain of the freon sales transactions in which the company was involved are the subject of a federal investigation and certain litigation brought by Airgas Inc against the company pending in the federal district court for the Southern District of Georgia.
